facts.quote:
The Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence was established within the United Nations 
through General Assembly resolution 79/325, as committed to through the Global Digital Compact and the Pact for the 
Future.
facts.summary: The supplied report states that General Assembly resolution 79/325 established the Panel within the UN, following commitments in the Global Digital Compact and Pact for the Future.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; institutional description, not an adopted intergovernmental decision

facts.quote: Composed of 40 independent experts appointed by the General Assembly for a term of three years
facts.summary: The report describes a Panel of 40 independent experts appointed by the General Assembly for three-year terms; it also states that membership is gender balanced and drawn from all five regional groups and multiple disciplines.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; institutional description, not an adopted intergovernmental decision

facts.quote:
The Panel is mandated to issue evidence-based scientific assessments synthesizing and analysing existing 
research related to the opportunities, risks and impacts of AI through an annual policy-relevant but non-prescriptive 
summary report including thematic briefs as it deems necessary.
facts.summary: The Panel's described mandate is to synthesize existing research on AI opportunities, risks and impacts in an annual policy-relevant, non-prescriptive report, with thematic briefs as needed.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; institutional description, not an adopted intergovernmental decision

facts.quote:
The Panel is also mandated to present its annual summary report at the United Nations Global Dialogue on Artificial 
Intelligence Governance.
facts.summary: The described mandate requires presentation of the annual summary report at the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance; this mandate alone does not establish that any later presentation occurred.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; institutional description, not an adopted intergovernmental decision

facts.quote:
In the three months since the Panel’s first meeting in March 2026, following their appointment in February 2026, the 
Panel worked intensively to deliver the present report.
facts.summary: The report dates the experts' appointment to February 2026 and their first meeting to March 2026, describing three months of preparation. It characterizes the present document as a preliminary baseline for wider consultation and subsequent thematic briefs and annual reports.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report describing its own preparation chronology and prospective follow-up

facts.quote: Panel members serve in their personal capacity as scientifically independent experts.
facts.summary: Members serve personally as independent scientific experts. The supplied text further states that, as UN experts on mission, they pledged not to seek or accept government or other outside instructions in performing their duties.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; institutional description, not an adopted intergovernmental decision
